runtime.final_audio: fixed Mandarin character TTS plus quiet room tone
runtime.subtitle_policy: burn Chinese speaker-label and English subtitles only after TTS QC

voice_lock.剑刺: low restrained adult Mandarin male; never a growl or monster voice
voice_lock.林浅: steady mid-low adult Mandarin female investigator
voice_lock.许未: clear firm adult Mandarin female analyst
voice_lock.周峤: precise measured young adult Mandarin male
voice_lock.罗川: calm adult Mandarin male project manager

episodes.viewer_question: 沈浩为什么严重失血，却没有明显的大伤口？

clips.speaker: 林浅
clips.zh: 剑刺，待销毁的样本少了一份。
clips.en: Jian Ci, one disposal sample is missing.

clips.speaker: 韩彻
clips.zh: 新案。骑手沈浩，严重失血。
clips.en: New case. Courier Shen Hao, severe blood loss.

clips.speaker: 许未
clips.zh: 衣物完整，也没有明显的大伤口。
clips.en: His clothing is intact. There is no major wound.

clips.speaker: 许未
clips.zh: 林浅，这枚贴布被反复揭开过。
clips.en: Lin Qian, this patch was lifted more than once.

clips.speaker: 许未
clips.zh: 折痕相同，说明是同一个人处理的。
clips.en: The matching folds point to the same handler.

clips.speaker: 周峤
clips.zh: 沈浩每周都去，间隔一模一样。
clips.en: Shen Hao went every week, at identical intervals.

clips.speaker: 林浅
clips.zh: 他不是来看病，是来领研究补贴。
clips.en: He came for a research stipend, not treatment.

clips.speaker: 许未
clips.zh: 上次结果已经异常，他不该再参加。
clips.en: His last result was abnormal. He should not have returned.

clips.speaker: 林浅
clips.zh: 为了生活签字，不等于知道全部风险。
clips.en: Signing for survival does not mean knowing every risk.

clips.speaker: 剑刺
clips.zh: 林浅，冷柜交给你。我退出证物区。
clips.en: Lin Qian, take the cold storage. I’m stepping out.

clips.speaker: 周峤
clips.zh: 林浅，沈浩最后一次预约，接他的是灰车。
clips.en: Lin Qian, a grey van collected Shen Hao for his last visit.

clips.speaker: 林浅
clips.zh: 周峤，追灰车。许未，锁住贴布证据。
clips.en: Zhou Qiao, trace the van. Xu Wei, secure the patch evidence.

episodes.viewer_question: 如果痕迹已经愈合，怎样证明沈浩遭遇了反复操作？

clips.speaker: 林浅
clips.zh: 沈浩反复参加研究，最后一次上了灰车。
clips.en: Shen Hao joined repeatedly. A grey van took him last.

clips.speaker: 许未
clips.zh: 三枚折痕同向，是同一套处理习惯。
clips.en: All three folds match the same handling routine.

clips.speaker: 许未
clips.zh: 间隔固定，这不是偶然，是排好的班。
clips.en: Fixed intervals mean a schedule, not an accident.

clips.speaker: 周峤
clips.zh: 林浅，灰车每周经过这三个夜间站点。
clips.en: Lin Qian, the van visits these three stops every week.

clips.speaker: 林浅
clips.zh: 没有治疗设备。这里只负责登记和转车。
clips.en: No treatment equipment. This place registers and transfers.

clips.speaker: 许未
clips.zh: 沈浩的合格，是在异常结果后补上的。
clips.en: Shen Hao was marked cleared after the abnormal result.

clips.speaker: 林浅
clips.zh: 剑刺，签过字，也不代表沈浩真正知情。
clips.en: Jian Ci, a signature does not prove informed consent.

clips.speaker: 周峤
clips.zh: 林浅，今晚还有一趟车，车上不止一人。
clips.en: Lin Qian, another van runs tonight—with several people.

clips.speaker: 剑刺
clips.zh: 林浅，别让我接近冷柜。你来保管。
clips.en: Lin Qian, keep me from the cold storage. You take custody.

clips.speaker: 周峤
clips.zh: 他们中途换车，再换地点，故意切断路线。
clips.en: They switch vehicles and sites to break the trail.

clips.speaker: 韩彻
clips.zh: 林浅，先救人，再取证。程序一个都不能少。
clips.en: Lin Qian, rescue first, evidence second—and follow procedure.

clips.speaker: 周峤
clips.zh: 林浅，灰车进旧仓库了。人还在里面。
clips.en: Lin Qian, the van entered the old warehouse. They’re inside.

episodes.viewer_question: 沈浩明明签了字，项目负责人为什么仍构成犯罪？

clips.speaker: 林浅
clips.zh: 沈浩签过字。现在要证明，他签字前被隐瞒了什么。
clips.en: Shen Hao signed. We must prove what was hidden from him.
clips.visual: 0.00-2.50 Rain-dark warehouse entrance: Lin Qian studies the closed entrance with an unmarked sealed hard case; Jian Ci holds position one step behind. 2.50-5.00 Both remain still as cold industrial light sweeps the shutter.

clips.speaker: 许未
clips.zh: 这里刚用过，他们撤得很急。
clips.en: This place was just used. They left in a hurry.
clips.visual: 0.00-2.50 Xu Wei examines a not-quite-closed unmarked hard case in the empty warehouse; paired stools and plain fabric dividers remain empty. 2.50-5.00 She notes the room layout without opening the case.

clips.speaker: 许未
clips.zh: 林浅，折痕吻合。沈浩来过这间仓库。
clips.en: Lin Qian, the folds match. Shen Hao was here.
clips.visual: 0.00-2.50 Xu Wei sets two separately sealed blank paper sleeves on different pads; raking light reveals matching diagonal folds. 2.50-5.00 Lin Qian observes from the clean boundary.

clips.speaker: 周峤
clips.zh: 三条路线都回到罗川名下的仓库。
clips.en: All three routes return to Luo Chuan’s warehouse.
clips.visual: 0.00-2.50 Zhou Qiao arranges three anonymous route strips on a physical city relief until they converge on one blank warehouse block. 2.50-5.00 Lin Qian understands the convergence.

clips.speaker: 林浅
clips.zh: 跟我走。今晚的项目已经停止。
clips.en: Come with me. Tonight’s program is over.
clips.visual: 0.00-2.50 Lin Qian calmly guides three fully clothed adult couriers from the warehouse interior across a clean boundary. 2.50-5.00 Jian Ci remains in the background, observing without touching anyone.

clips.speaker: 韩彻
clips.zh: 人员登记，证物分开封存，现场全程留痕。
clips.en: Register everyone. Seal evidence separately. Record the scene.
clips.visual: 0.00-2.50 Han Che directs people safely out through the distant exit while Xu Wei seals separate unmarked hard cases in the foreground. 2.50-5.00 Lin Qian holds the clean boundary.

clips.speaker: 罗川
clips.zh: 他们自愿来的，每个人都签了字。
clips.en: They volunteered. Every one of them signed.
clips.visual: 0.00-2.50 Luo Chuan, a normal adult Chinese project manager in a charcoal jacket, faces Lin Qian across an empty metal table. 2.50-5.00 A closed unmarked evidence case remains between them.

clips.speaker: 林浅
clips.zh: 你隐瞒风险。拿补贴，不等于知情同意。
clips.en: You hid the risks. Taking money is not informed consent.
clips.visual: 0.00-2.50 Lin Qian sets one sealed unmarked hard case down on the steel table, composed and firm. 2.50-5.00 Cold rain reflection crosses the office; the unseen listener remains offscreen.

clips.speaker: 许未
clips.zh: 异常在前，合格在后。记录被改过。
clips.en: The abnormal result came first. The clearance was added later.
clips.visual: 0.00-2.50 Xu Wei holds a sealed blank cream card in oblique light; two blind-embossed layers are visible with no glyphs. 2.50-5.00 Han Che confirms the sealed state from beyond the boundary.

clips.speaker: 周峤
clips.zh: 同一批账号、同一周期、同一条转移线。
clips.en: The same accounts, cycle, and transfer route.
clips.visual: 0.00-2.50 Zhou Qiao arranges equal-spaced anonymous tokens and three route strips to one warehouse block on a physical model. 2.50-5.00 Lin Qian sees the complete pattern.

clips.speaker: 韩彻
clips.zh: 证物、记录和路线闭合。罗川，依法接受调查。
clips.en: Evidence, records, and routes align. Luo Chuan, you are under investigation.
clips.visual: 0.00-2.50 Han Che closes one unmarked evidence case. 2.50-5.00 Luo Chuan walks out with two plain-clothed staff in the distant background; Lin Qian and Jian Ci remain at the evidence line.

clips.speaker: 林浅
clips.zh: 沈浩的案子结束了。剑刺，现在解释冷柜。
clips.en: Shen Hao’s case is closed. Jian Ci—now explain the cold storage.
clips.visual: 0.00-2.50 Back in the blue-black evidence corridor, Lin Qian faces Jian Ci across the clean boundary near a shut brushed-steel cold cabinet. 2.50-5.00 One empty rectangular recess is visible as both keep distance from the cabinet.

visual_safety.story_rule: Jian Ci never harms anyone and never provides a supernatural solution.
